items.title: Joanne Brackeen interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 10, 2001
items.q: Another person I really like is the couple Chick and Gayle. I really like them. I’d like to do something with them.

ctx.x: Less things that are — you know, but we know more about the body too, so that’s kind of nice. The energy is better. And a lot of people learn so fast in the schooling, these kids learn so fast. It would be nice if we could, well you know, try to balance the inner knowledge, I think that’s the thing that has to happen now because we’re kind of going for the outer knowledge and at some point it’s just like the NASDAQ dropping way down. I think we have to get that together with the inner knowledge so that the human…
